faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Central University of Kashmir for filling up research positions in the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The post offered is Research Associate under a HEFA sponsored research project at the Central University of Kashmir.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for Central University of Kashmir Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate position is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E/M.Tech in Structural Engineering or Transportation Engineering with a CGPA of 6.5 or not less than 60%, along with a Ph.D awarded or submitted and research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary provided for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through online mode by submitting their application details along with the required documents through the specified links.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Central University of Kashmir Research Associate?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where should physical copies or offline documents be addressed if required?
faq.answer: Applications along with all relevant documents should be sent to Dr. Asif Hussain Shah (PI), Department of Civil Engineering, Central University of Kashmir, Tulmulla campus, Ganderbal-191131.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I visit to check the official updates and website?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the university at www.cukashmir.ac.in for all the latest updates regarding the recruitment process.
